title: Downtown Boathouse

services.name: Free Kayaking
services.desc: The Downtown Boathouse offers sit-on-top kayaks for public use in the protected Hudson River embayment north of Pier 26 on the west side of Manhattan. Our free kayaking program provides an opportunity for New Yorkers and visitors to get out on the water, experience our waterfront from a different perspective, and see how far we’ve come in cleaning up the Hudson River. Closing time is when the last boats go out so plan on arriving earlier in order to kayak. We don’t take reservations, so arrive early for shorter lines and to ensure you get a chance to kayak. No previous kayaking experience is necessary, but you must know how to swim. Our volunteers will give you basic paddling instructions,
